newsitem.title: USA: D & P upgrades Parker & Parsley senior debt.
newsitem.headline: D & P upgrades Parker & Parsley senior debt.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it upgraded its rating of Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co senior debt to Triple B from Triple B Minus.
It also raised the company's monthly income preferred securities to Double B Plus from Double B.
This rating action affects $300 million in debt and $188.8 million in preferred securities.

Improved operating cash flows and earnings in combination with the divestiture of the company's wholly owned Australian subsidiaries and Bridge Oil Timor Sea assets in 1996 allowed the company to reduce debt, Duff & Phelps noted.
